items.finding: mod_deck_compare.R behavior 'a refused fetch or a refused deck ... leaves any prior result standing rather than blanking the view' (milestone 4) is a non-trivial UX choice with no supporting DL entry; its decision_refs (DL-037, DL-036, DL-038) cover persistence, extraction, and copy-count placement, none address stale-result-on-failure behavior

items.check: DL-032 reverses the task spec's two-cause-split MUST and says so explicitly, so the divergence is visible to a reader holding the original spec
items.finding: DL-032 justifies merging the two causes on schema grounds but never states that this reverses the task-spec MUST requiring a two-cause split; a reader holding the original spec is not alerted to the divergence.
